title: Software Development Costs - ASC 985-20
description: Guide to software development cost capitalization including technological feasibility, amortization, and impairment for software products.

sections.title: Software Development Costs
sections.content: TO BE COMPLETED - ASC 985-20 for software products, technological feasibility, detail program design, working model, R&D vs capitalizable costs, amortization (greater of straight-line or revenue-based), impairment, internal-use software (ASC 350-40), cloud computing arrangements (ASC 350-40).
